=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1513 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The root guard omits the vetted read-loop exemption and loop-specific safe-rewrite hint present in the template guard, so the copies diverge.
  WHY: The root guard asks on approvable literal-ID read loops and fails the root-hook tests and template-parity check; reviewers report 7 CI failures that make the aggregate lint check red and block merge.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:1, 10 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The root command says Claude is the active engine for every project role, while the engine label remains inert until Phase 6.
  WHY: Operators are told the command runs on Claude when engine selection is pending Phase 6; reviewers rated this BLOCKER and MAJOR, so the higher severity is retained.
- .claude/commands/implement-issue-claude.md:1, 12, 20 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The root command says the issue runs on Claude and reports the engine label as added without verifying the label write succeeded, while engine selection remains pending Phase 6.
  WHY: Operators are given a false active-engine expectation and the command does not confirm the label was applied; reviewers rated this BLOCKER and MAJOR, so the higher severity is retained.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1513 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The root guard omits the read-loop exemption and loop-specific safe-rewrite hint present in the template guard.
  WHY: `tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py` loads the root guard, and the template-parity assertion fails; CI reports 7 failures, making the aggregate `lint` check red and blocking merge.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:1, 10 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The root command promises active Claude execution for every role even though the engine label is inert pending Phase 6.
  WHY: An operator following the command will believe Claude is running the project when each role still uses its configured engine.
- .claude/commands/implement-issue-claude.md:1, 12, 20 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The root command promises active Claude execution and reports the label as added without verifying the write succeeded.
  WHY: The root command promises active Claude execution when the label is inert pending Phase 6.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The PR description says "/implement-plan-claude and /implement-issue-claude are now thin hand-offs to the Actions pipeline" and "The ai:engine-claude label they add stays inert until Phase 6 (D4)." The PR diff updates the template copies but not the root `.claude/commands/` copies.
  Expected change site: .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md and .claude/commands/implement-issue-claude.md
  Evidence of absence: The root plan command at `.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:1` still says "on the Claude engine" and "so every role of its work runs `claude -p` with Claude Opus 5.5 at `high` effort inside the Actions pipelines." The root issue command at `.claude/commands/implement-issue-claude.md:1` still says "on the Claude engine" and line 20 says "Engine: Claude (ai:engine-claude added)." Neither root copy reflects the inert-label behaviour the template copies now document. The root `implement-plan-claude.md` is NOT in PR CHANGED FILES; the root `implement-issue-claude.md` is NOT in PR CHANGED FILES. The LAST RUN DIFF only touched the template copies.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The PR diff in `tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py` moves five `gh api` commands from `test_literal_id_read_loop_is_allowed` to a new `test_unvetted_loop_with_unquoted_api_expansion_asks` function expecting `DECISION_ASK`. The PR diff in `workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1513` adds the `and not _is_approvable_read_loop(command, results)` exemption so those loops no longer fall through the unconditional ask path into the read-loop allow. The root guard at `.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1513` must carry the same change for the tests to pass and for same-behaviour parity.
  Expected change site: .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py line 1513-1517
  Evidence of absence: The root guard at line 1513 reads `if _unquoted_gh_api_expansion(stripped_command):` with no `and not _is_approvable_read_loop(command, results)` clause and no loop-specific hint at line 1517. The template guard carries both. The template parity test at line 1024 asserts byte-identical copies; it fails. CI shows 7 test failures.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The PR diff adds assertions in `tests/test_ai_labels_retired.py:83-84` that `ai:engine-claude` is in the label contract's `labels` array and not in `retired_labels`.
  Expected change site: .github/ai/label_contract.v1.json
  Evidence of absence: grepping the label contract for `ai:engine-claude` returns no match. The label exists nowhere in the contract. The test assertion `assert "ai:engine-claude" in contract["labels"]` will fail at runtime because the contract was not updated to include it. The merge with main may have been expected to carry this label (Phase 3/4 added the engine plumbing), but at the current HEAD the label is absent.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
